prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for a premium hand-painted 2D side-scrolling Mexican Día de Muertos fantasy platformer. Create a wide HORIZONTAL TRANSPARENT PARALLAX ARCHITECTURE PANORAMA, 1536x1024 canvas, no sky and no ground plane, genuinely transparent alpha around the silhouette. A beautiful old Mexican secondary-school courtyard building complex at night: long cream and aged teal stucco facades, red terracotta tiled roofs, two-storey colonnaded arcades, ornate school entrance, a modest central clock tower (simple clock without numerals), warmly glowing classroom windows, library wing with small book emblems, courtyard trees, strings of orange magenta and turquoise papel picado, generous marigold planters and a few candles respecting remembrance. Scenic storybook animation quality: rich painterly gouache textures, soft atmospheric lighting, deep indigo outlines, beautifully coherent shapes, a little magical teal glow. FRONT ELEVATION, strictly side-on, architectural composition filling lower 2/3 width, varied roof heights, most buildings are low to preserve open upper third. Both ends fade naturally into low flowering garden walls for overlap tiling. Broad complete silhouette fully inside canvas; translucent night-haze details. This is a non-collidable distant parallax layer; no foreground playable ledges, platforms or characters, no HUD, no text, no letters, no pixel art, no emoji, no solid background. Warm gold light with teal stone contrasts, matching ornate Mexican fantasy illustration.

All decor associated with remembering loved ones, not horror.

Use case: stylized-concept. Game asset ATLAS for premium hand-painted 2D Mexican Día de Muertos fantasy platformer. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, exact 3 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells on a 1536x1024 canvas. Six fully separate original illustrations, each centered with generous empty transparent margins, no touching neighbors, no text, no grid. Cohesive polished storybook cartoon gouache, soft shaded surfaces, deep indigo ink outlines, golden ochre accents and teal/magenta details, realistic alpha, no pixel art or emoji. Top row: 1 small ornate gold oval family portrait frame, contains a warm expressive illustration of two smiling parents and teenager, surrounded by marigolds; 2 closed turquoise school exercise book with blue ribbon bookmark and golden star embossing, no writing; 3 beautifully folded cream paper town map with tiny hand-drawn colorful streets and landmarks, visible route marked in gold, no lettering. Bottom row: 4 tall wood and teal school noticeboard on TWO wooden legs, three small blank cream note papers and miniature flower garland, clearly decorative upright furniture not walkable platform; 5 carved wooden street signpost on one sturdy post, THREE blank arrow-shaped signs pointing in different directions, marigold at base, no words; 6 elegant large stone garden arch carved with ornamental stylized calaveras, glowing marigolds along its sides, open transparent center and no doors, soft turquoise golden magic, obvious passage marker. All objects viewed SIDE ON front elevation for a platform game. All six objects complete and fully inside own equal 512x512 cell, no scenery background. Shadows only inside objects, alpha outside.
